text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober sharpens her skills
alongside 
Mejiro Bright, who is preparing for her 
debut race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sensing a change in Mejiro Dober after
her 
Debut race, Mejiro Bright proposes that 
the two of them strive together for a
"new era of Mejiro glory."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Beneath the setting sun, Mejiro Dober and 
Mejiro Bright vow to strive forward
toward 
the Triple Tiara and the Classic Triple 
Crown respectively.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Mejiro Dober's next target was 
decided: the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies, 
prelude to the Triple Tiara!
